name: mypdf
description: Privacy-first PDF toolbox for the desktop
author: chishengchen

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:backend && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.build:mac:clean: npm run rebuild:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.package:mac: npm run rebuild:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:backend:portable && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:backend:portable && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
